import bpy, numpy as np, math, time
from mathutils import Vector
from mathutils.bvhtree import BVHTree
names=['Part_49','Part_17','Part_26','Part_38']
print('units',bpy.context.scene.unit_settings.system,bpy.context.scene.unit_settings.scale_length)
for name in names:
 obj=bpy.data.objects.get(name)
 print(name, None if obj is None else (obj.type,len(obj.data.vertices),len(obj.data.polygons),tuple(obj.dimensions),[list(row) for row in obj.matrix_world]))

dg=bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
geom={}
for name in names:
 obj=bpy.data.objects[name].evaluated_get(dg); mesh=obj.to_mesh(); mesh.calc_loop_triangles()
 local=np.array([v.co[:] for v in mesh.vertices],dtype=np.float64)
 matrix=np.array(obj.matrix_world,dtype=np.float64)
 vertices=local@matrix[:3,:3].T+matrix[:3,3]
 triangles=np.array([t.vertices[:] for t in mesh.loop_triangles],dtype=int)
 edges=np.unique(np.sort(np.concatenate([triangles[:,[0,1]],triangles[:,[1,2]],triangles[:,[2,0]]]),axis=1),axis=0)
 geom[name]={'v':vertices,'f':triangles,'e':edges,'tri':vertices[triangles]}
 print(name,'bbox_mm',vertices.min(axis=0)*1000,vertices.max(axis=0)*1000,'triangles',len(triangles),'modifiers',[(m.name,m.type) for m in obj.modifiers])
 obj.to_mesh_clear()
def solid_angles(points,tris):
 rel=tris[None,:,:,:]-points[:,None,None,:]
 lengths=np.linalg.norm(rel,axis=-1)
 numerator=np.einsum('pti,pti->pt',rel[:,:,0],np.cross(rel[:,:,1],rel[:,:,2]))
 denominator=lengths.prod(axis=-1)+np.einsum('pti,pti->pt',rel[:,:,0],rel[:,:,1])*lengths[:,:,2]+np.einsum('pti,pti->pt',rel[:,:,1],rel[:,:,2])*lengths[:,:,0]+np.einsum('pti,pti->pt',rel[:,:,2],rel[:,:,0])*lengths[:,:,1]
 return np.sum(2*np.arctan2(numerator,denominator),axis=1)/(4*np.pi)
for name in names[1:]:
 target=geom['Part_49']; candidate=geom[name]
 print(name,'vertex_winding_in_target',np.round(solid_angles(candidate['v'],target['tri']),5).tolist())
 print(name,'target_winding_range',np.min(solid_angles(target['v'],candidate['tri'])),np.max(solid_angles(target['v'],candidate['tri'])))

def vertex_face_min(points,tris):
 origin=tris[:,0]; side1=tris[:,1]-origin; side2=tris[:,2]-origin
 normals=np.cross(side1,side2); normal2=np.sum(normals*normals,axis=1)
 displacement=points[:,None,:]-origin[None,:,:]
 height=np.einsum('pfi,fi->pf',displacement,normals)/normal2[None,:]
 projected=points[:,None,:]-height[:,:,None]*normals[None,:,:]
 offset=projected-origin[None,:,:]
 aa=np.sum(side1*side1,axis=1); bb=np.sum(side1*side2,axis=1); cc=np.sum(side2*side2,axis=1)
 dd=np.einsum('pfi,fi->pf',offset,side1); ee=np.einsum('pfi,fi->pf',offset,side2)
 denom=aa*cc-bb*bb
 uu=(cc*dd-bb*ee)/denom; vv=(aa*ee-bb*dd)/denom
 valid=(uu>=-1e-12)&(vv>=-1e-12)&(uu+vv<=1+1e-12)
 dist2=np.where(valid,height*height*normal2,np.inf)
 point_index,face_index=np.unravel_index(np.argmin(dist2),dist2.shape)
 return float(dist2[point_index,face_index]),points[point_index],projected[point_index,face_index]
def edge_edge_min(first,second):
 first_start=first[:,0,None,:]; second_start=second[None,:,0,:]
 first_dir=(first[:,1]-first[:,0])[:,None,:]; second_dir=(second[:,1]-second[:,0])[None,:,:]
 offset=first_start-second_start
 aa=np.sum(first_dir*first_dir,axis=-1); bb=np.sum(first_dir*second_dir,axis=-1); cc=np.sum(second_dir*second_dir,axis=-1)
 dd=np.sum(first_dir*offset,axis=-1); ee=np.sum(second_dir*offset,axis=-1)
 denom=aa*cc-bb*bb
 safe=np.where(denom>1e-30,denom,1.)
 ss=(bb*ee-cc*dd)/safe; tt=(aa*ee-bb*dd)/safe
 options=[(ss,tt,(denom>1e-30)&(ss>=0)&(ss<=1)&(tt>=0)&(tt<=1)),(np.zeros_like(dd),np.clip(ee/cc,0,1),True),(np.ones_like(dd),np.clip((ee+bb)/cc,0,1),True),(np.clip(-dd/aa,0,1),np.zeros_like(ee),True),(np.clip((bb-dd)/aa,0,1),np.ones_like(ee),True)]
 best=(float('inf'),None,None)
 for ss,tt,valid in options:
  point1=first_start+ss[:,:,None]*first_dir; point2=second_start+tt[:,:,None]*second_dir
  dist2=np.where(valid,np.sum((point1-point2)**2,axis=-1),np.inf)
  idx=np.unravel_index(np.argmin(dist2),dist2.shape)
  if dist2[idx]<best[0]: best=(float(dist2[idx]),point1[idx],point2[idx])
 return best
for name in names[1:]:
 target=geom['Part_49']; candidate=geom[name]
 results=[vertex_face_min(candidate['v'],target['tri']),vertex_face_min(target['v'],candidate['tri']),edge_edge_min(candidate['v'][candidate['e']],target['v'][target['e']])]
 best=min(results,key=lambda item:item[0])
 print(name,'feature_distances_mm',[math.sqrt(item[0])*1000 for item in results],'best_points_mm',best[1]*1000,best[2]*1000)
 # Manifold check and surface-crossing broad phase, with solid-angle evidence above identifying penetration.
 for label,geometry in [('target',target),('candidate',candidate)]:
  all_edges=np.sort(np.concatenate([geometry['f'][:,[0,1]],geometry['f'][:,[1,2]],geometry['f'][:,[2,0]]]),axis=1)
  counts=np.unique(all_edges,axis=0,return_counts=True)[1]
  print(label,'edge_incidence',np.unique(counts,return_counts=True))
 tree_target=BVHTree.FromPolygons(target['v'].tolist(),target['f'].tolist(),all_triangles=True,epsilon=0.0)
 tree_candidate=BVHTree.FromPolygons(candidate['v'].tolist(),candidate['f'].tolist(),all_triangles=True,epsilon=0.0)
 print('surface_overlap_pairs',len(tree_target.overlap(tree_candidate)))

import bpy, numpy as np, math, time
objs=[o for o in bpy.context.scene.objects if o.type=='MESH']
print('units',bpy.context.scene.unit_settings.system,bpy.context.scene.unit_settings.scale_length)
print('mesh_count',len(objs))
print([(o.name,len(o.data.vertices),len(o.data.polygons),len(o.modifiers)) for o in objs])

depsgraph=bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
geometry={}
for obj in objs:
    evaluated=obj.evaluated_get(depsgraph)
    matrix=np.array(evaluated.matrix_world,dtype=np.float64)
    vertices=np.array([tuple(vertex.co) for vertex in evaluated.data.vertices],dtype=np.float64)
    vertices=vertices@matrix[:3,:3].T+matrix[:3,3]
    faces=[tuple(poly.vertices) for poly in evaluated.data.polygons]
    geometry[obj.name]=(vertices,np.array([(face[0],face[index],face[index+1]) for face in faces for index in range(1,len(face)-1)],dtype=int))
    print(obj.name,'bounds',vertices.min(axis=0).tolist(),vertices.max(axis=0).tolist(),'face_sizes',sorted(set(map(len,faces))))
print('target_world_matrix',np.array(bpy.data.objects['Mesh_D17AB2'].matrix_world).tolist())

def surface_distance(first, second):
    first_vertices,first_indices=first
    second_vertices,second_indices=second
    first_triangles=first_vertices[first_indices]
    second_triangles=second_vertices[second_indices]
    best=[float('inf'),None,None,None]
    def submit(distances, points_a, points_b, kind, reverse=False):
        flat_index=int(np.argmin(distances))
        distance=float(distances.flat[flat_index])
        if distance < best[0]:
            index=np.unravel_index(flat_index,distances.shape)
            point_a=np.broadcast_to(points_a,distances.shape+(3,))[index].copy()
            point_b=np.broadcast_to(points_b,distances.shape+(3,))[index].copy()
            best[:]=[distance,point_b if reverse else point_a,point_a if reverse else point_b,kind]
    def point_face(points,triangles,reverse):
        origin=triangles[:,0]
        edge_u=triangles[:,1]-origin
        edge_v=triangles[:,2]-origin
        normals=np.cross(edge_u,edge_v)
        norm_squared=np.einsum('ij,ij->i',normals,normals)
        relative=points[:,None,:]-origin[None,:,:]
        signed=np.einsum('pfi,fi->pf',relative,normals)/norm_squared[None,:]
        projected=points[:,None,:]-signed[:,:,None]*normals[None,:,:]
        offset=projected-origin[None,:,:]
        uu=np.einsum('ij,ij->i',edge_u,edge_u)
        uv=np.einsum('ij,ij->i',edge_u,edge_v)
        vv=np.einsum('ij,ij->i',edge_v,edge_v)
        pu=np.einsum('pfi,fi->pf',offset,edge_u)
        pv=np.einsum('pfi,fi->pf',offset,edge_v)
        denominator=uu*vv-uv*uv
        bary_u=(vv*pu-uv*pv)/denominator
        bary_v=(uu*pv-uv*pu)/denominator
        inside=(bary_u>=-1e-13)&(bary_v>=-1e-13)&(bary_u+bary_v<=1+1e-13)
        distance_squared=np.sum((points[:,None,:]-projected)**2,axis=2)
        submit(np.where(inside,distance_squared,np.inf),points[:,None,:],projected,'vertex-face',reverse)
    point_face(first_vertices,second_triangles,False)
    point_face(second_vertices,first_triangles,True)
    def edges(triangles):
        return triangles.reshape(-1,3),triangles[:,[1,2,0],:].reshape(-1,3)
    start_a,end_a=edges(first_triangles)
    start_b,end_b=edges(second_triangles)
    vector_a=end_a-start_a
    vector_b=end_b-start_b
    def points_segments(points,starts,vectors,reverse):
        relative=points[:,None,:]-starts[None,:,:]
        parameters=np.clip(np.einsum('psi,si->ps',relative,vectors)/np.einsum('si,si->s',vectors,vectors),0,1)
        projections=starts[None,:,:]+parameters[:,:,None]*vectors[None,:,:]
        submit(np.sum((points[:,None,:]-projections)**2,axis=2),points[:,None,:],projections,'vertex-edge',reverse)
    points_segments(first_vertices,start_b,vector_b,False)
    points_segments(second_vertices,start_a,vector_a,True)
    relative=start_a[:,None,:]-start_b[None,:,:]
    aa=np.einsum('ij,ij->i',vector_a,vector_a)[:,None]
    bb=np.einsum('ij,kj->ik',vector_a,vector_b)
    cc=np.einsum('ij,ij->i',vector_b,vector_b)[None,:]
    dd=np.einsum('abi,ai->ab',relative,vector_a)
    ee=np.einsum('abi,bi->ab',relative,vector_b)
    determinant=aa*cc-bb*bb
    safe=np.where(determinant>1e-28,determinant,1.0)
    parameter_a=(bb*ee-cc*dd)/safe
    parameter_b=(aa*ee-bb*dd)/safe
    eligible=(determinant>1e-28)&(parameter_a>=0)&(parameter_a<=1)&(parameter_b>=0)&(parameter_b<=1)
    points_a=start_a[:,None,:]+parameter_a[:,:,None]*vector_a[:,None,:]
    points_b=start_b[None,:,:]+parameter_b[:,:,None]*vector_b[None,:,:]
    submit(np.where(eligible,np.sum((points_a-points_b)**2,axis=2),np.inf),points_a,points_b,'edge-edge')
    def intersections(starts,vectors,triangles,reverse):
        edge_u=triangles[:,1]-triangles[:,0]
        edge_v=triangles[:,2]-triangles[:,0]
        cross=np.cross(vectors[:,None,:],edge_v[None,:,:])
        det=np.einsum('fi,sfi->sf',edge_u,cross)
        safe_det=np.where(np.abs(det)>1e-20,det,1.0)
        relative=starts[:,None,:]-triangles[None,:,0,:]
        bary_u=np.einsum('sfi,sfi->sf',relative,cross)/safe_det
        cross_second=np.cross(relative,edge_u[None,:,:])
        bary_v=np.einsum('si,sfi->sf',vectors,cross_second)/safe_det
        parameter=np.einsum('fi,sfi->sf',edge_v,cross_second)/safe_det
        hits=(np.abs(det)>1e-20)&(bary_u>=0)&(bary_v>=0)&(bary_u+bary_v<=1)&(parameter>=0)&(parameter<=1)
        if hits.any():
            points=starts[:,None,:]+parameter[:,:,None]*vectors[:,None,:]
            submit(np.where(hits,0.0,np.inf),points,points,'surface-intersection',reverse)
    intersections(start_a,vector_a,second_triangles,False)
    intersections(start_b,vector_b,first_triangles,True)
    return [math.sqrt(best[0]),best[1].tolist(),best[2].tolist(),best[3]]

import bpy, numpy as np, math, time
from mathutils import Vector
from mathutils.bvhtree import BVHTree
scene=bpy.context.scene
print('units',scene.unit_settings.system,scene.unit_settings.scale_length)
print('meshes',[(o.name,len(o.data.vertices),len(o.data.polygons)) for o in scene.objects if o.type=='MESH'])
print('target',bpy.data.objects.get('Mesh_D17AB2'))

dg=bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
geo={}
for obj in scene.objects:
    if obj.type!='MESH': continue
    ev=obj.evaluated_get(dg); mesh=ev.to_mesh(); mesh.calc_loop_triangles()
    local=np.array([v.co[:] for v in mesh.vertices],dtype=np.float64)
    mat=np.array(ev.matrix_world,dtype=np.float64)
    verts=local @ mat[:3,:3].T + mat[:3,3]
    tris=np.array([t.vertices[:] for t in mesh.loop_triangles],dtype=np.int64)
    edges=np.unique(np.sort(np.concatenate([tris[:,[0,1]],tris[:,[1,2]],tris[:,[2,0]]]),axis=1),axis=0)
    geo[obj.name]={'v':verts,'t':tris,'e':edges}
    print(obj.name,'evaluated',len(verts),len(tris),'bounds',verts.min(axis=0).tolist(),verts.max(axis=0).tolist(),'modifiers',[(m.name,m.type) for m in obj.modifiers])
    ev.to_mesh_clear()

def point_triangle_min(points,triangles):
    p=points[:,None,:]; a=triangles[None,:,0,:]; b=triangles[None,:,1,:]; c=triangles[None,:,2,:]
    ab=b-a; ac=c-a; normal=np.cross(ab,ac); nn=np.sum(normal*normal,axis=-1)
    offset=np.sum((p-a)*normal,axis=-1)/nn
    q=p-offset[...,None]*normal
    aq=q-a; d00=np.sum(ab*ab,axis=-1); d01=np.sum(ab*ac,axis=-1); d11=np.sum(ac*ac,axis=-1)
    d20=np.sum(aq*ab,axis=-1); d21=np.sum(aq*ac,axis=-1); denom=d00*d11-d01*d01
    u=(d11*d20-d01*d21)/denom; v=(d00*d21-d01*d20)/denom
    inside=(u>=-1e-13)&(v>=-1e-13)&(u+v<=1+1e-13)
    dd=np.sum((p-q)**2,axis=-1); dd[~inside]=np.inf
    idx=np.unravel_index(np.argmin(dd),dd.shape)
    best=(float(dd[idx]),points[idx[0]].copy(),q[idx].copy(),'vertex-face')
    for start,end in [(a,b),(b,c),(c,a)]:
        edge=end-start; t=np.sum((p-start)*edge,axis=-1)/np.sum(edge*edge,axis=-1)
        r=start+np.clip(t,0,1)[...,None]*edge
        dd=np.sum((p-r)**2,axis=-1); idx=np.unravel_index(np.argmin(dd),dd.shape)
        if dd[idx]<best[0]: best=(float(dd[idx]),points[idx[0]].copy(),r[idx].copy(),'vertex-edge')
    return best

def edge_edge_min(edges_a,edges_b):
    p=edges_a[:,None,0,:]; q=edges_b[None,:,0,:]
    u=edges_a[:,None,1,:]-p; v=edges_b[None,:,1,:]-q; w=p-q
    aa=np.sum(u*u,axis=-1); bb=np.sum(u*v,axis=-1); cc=np.sum(v*v,axis=-1)
    dd=np.sum(u*w,axis=-1); ee=np.sum(v*w,axis=-1); denom=aa*cc-bb*bb
    valid=denom>1e-25
    s=np.divide(bb*ee-cc*dd,denom,out=np.zeros_like(denom),where=valid)
    t=np.divide(aa*ee-bb*dd,denom,out=np.zeros_like(denom),where=valid)
    valid &= (s>=0)&(s<=1)&(t>=0)&(t<=1)
    pa=p+s[...,None]*u; pb=q+t[...,None]*v
    dist=np.sum((pa-pb)**2,axis=-1); dist[~valid]=np.inf
    idx=np.unravel_index(np.argmin(dist),dist.shape)
    return float(dist[idx]),pa[idx].copy(),pb[idx].copy(),'edge-edge'

def segment_triangle_hit(edges,triangles):
    p=edges[:,None,0,:]; direction=edges[:,None,1,:]-p
    a=triangles[None,:,0,:]; ab=triangles[None,:,1,:]-a; ac=triangles[None,:,2,:]-a
    h=np.cross(direction,ac); det=np.sum(ab*h,axis=-1); valid=np.abs(det)>1e-18
    inv=np.divide(1.,det,out=np.zeros_like(det),where=valid)
    s=p-a; u=inv*np.sum(s*h,axis=-1); q=np.cross(s,ab)
    v=inv*np.sum(direction*q,axis=-1); t=inv*np.sum(ac*q,axis=-1)
    hit=valid&(u>=-1e-12)&(v>=-1e-12)&(u+v<=1+1e-12)&(t>=-1e-12)&(t<=1+1e-12)
    if hit.any():
        idx=tuple(np.argwhere(hit)[0]); point=(p+t[...,None]*direction)[idx]
        return (0.,point.copy(),point.copy(),'intersection')
    return None

target=geo['Mesh_D17AB2']; results={}
for name,other in geo.items():
    if name=='Mesh_D17AB2': continue
    va=target['v']; vb=other['v']; ta=va[target['t']]; tb=vb[other['t']]; ea=va[target['e']]; eb=vb[other['e']]
    candidates=[point_triangle_min(va,tb),edge_edge_min(ea,eb)]
    rev=point_triangle_min(vb,ta); candidates.append((rev[0],rev[2],rev[1],rev[3]+' reversed'))
    for hit in [segment_triangle_hit(ea,tb),segment_triangle_hit(eb,ta)]:
        if hit is not None: candidates.append(hit)
    best=min(candidates,key=lambda value:value[0]); results[name]=best
for name,best in sorted(results.items(),key=lambda item:item[1][0]):
    print(name,'distance_mm',format(math.sqrt(best[0])*scene.unit_settings.scale_length*1000,'.12f'),'target_point_m',best[1].tolist(),'other_point_m',best[2].tolist(),'feature',best[3])

from mathutils import Vector
from mathutils.bvhtree import BVHTree

target=bpy.data.objects.get('Mesh_DDBB95')

print('target',target.name if target else None)
print('meshes',[(o.name,len(o.data.vertices),len(o.data.polygons)) for o in scene.objects if o.type=='MESH'])

depsgraph=bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
mesh_cache={}
for obj in scene.objects:
    if obj.type!='MESH': continue
    evaluated=obj.evaluated_get(depsgraph)
    mesh=evaluated.to_mesh()
    mesh.calc_loop_triangles()
    local=np.array([tuple(v.co) for v in mesh.vertices],dtype=np.float64)
    matrix=np.array(evaluated.matrix_world,dtype=np.float64)
    verts=local @ matrix[:3,:3].T + matrix[:3,3]
    indices=np.array([tuple(tri.vertices) for tri in mesh.loop_triangles],dtype=int)
    mesh_cache[obj.name]={'verts':verts,'indices':indices,'triangles':verts[indices]}
    evaluated.to_mesh_clear()
    print(obj.name,'triangles',len(indices),'bounds_m',verts.min(axis=0).tolist(),verts.max(axis=0).tolist(),'modifiers',[(m.name,m.type) for m in obj.modifiers])
print('mm_per_unit',scene.unit_settings.scale_length*1000)

def nearest_surfaces(first, second):
    tri_a=first['triangles']; tri_b=second['triangles']
    best={'distance2':float('inf')}
    def consider(dist2, points_a, points_b, label):
        index=np.unravel_index(np.argmin(dist2),dist2.shape)
        value=float(dist2[index])
        if value<best['distance2']:
            best.update(distance2=value,point_a=np.array(points_a[index]).tolist(),point_b=np.array(points_b[index]).tolist(),feature=label,index=index)
    edges_a=np.stack([tri_a[:,[0,1]],tri_a[:,[1,2]],tri_a[:,[2,0]]],axis=1).reshape(-1,2,3)
    edges_b=np.stack([tri_b[:,[0,1]],tri_b[:,[1,2]],tri_b[:,[2,0]]],axis=1).reshape(-1,2,3)
    p=edges_a[:,0,None,:]; u=(edges_a[:,1]-edges_a[:,0])[:,None,:]
    q=edges_b[None,:,0,:]; v=(edges_b[:,1]-edges_b[:,0])[None,:,:]
    shape=(len(edges_a),len(edges_b),3)
    uu=np.sum(u*u,axis=-1); vv=np.sum(v*v,axis=-1)
    for endpoint in (0,1):
        pa=p+endpoint*u
        parameter=np.clip(np.sum((pa-q)*v,axis=-1)/vv,0,1)
        pb=q+parameter[...,None]*v
        pa=np.broadcast_to(pa,shape)
        consider(np.sum((pa-pb)**2,axis=-1),pa,pb,'edgeA endpoint / edgeB')

def dot(a,b): return np.einsum('...i,...i->...',a,b)
def triangle_pair_distances(ta,tb):
    count_a,count_b=len(ta),len(tb)
    aa=np.repeat(ta,count_b,axis=0); bb=np.tile(tb,(count_a,1,1))
    n=len(aa); best=np.full(n,np.inf); pa=np.zeros((n,3)); pb=np.zeros((n,3)); hit=np.zeros(n,dtype=bool)
    def update(x,y,valid=None):
        dd=dot(x-y,x-y)
        mask=dd<best
        if valid is not None: mask &= valid
        best[mask]=dd[mask]; pa[mask]=x[mask]; pb[mask]=y[mask]
    for rev in (False,True):
        src,dst=(bb,aa) if rev else (aa,bb)
        base=dst[:,0]; u=dst[:,1]-base; v=dst[:,2]-base
        norm=np.cross(u,v); norm2=dot(norm,norm)
        uu=dot(u,u); uv=dot(u,v); vv=dot(v,v); det=uu*vv-uv*uv
        for k in range(3):
            point=src[:,k]
            offset=point-base
            projected=point-(dot(offset,norm)/norm2)[:,None]*norm
            rel=projected-base
            pu=dot(rel,u); pv=dot(rel,v)
            alpha=(vv*pu-uv*pv)/det; beta=(uu*pv-uv*pu)/det
            valid=(alpha>=-1e-13)&(beta>=-1e-13)&(alpha+beta<=1+1e-13)
            update(projected,point,valid) if rev else update(point,projected,valid)
            end=src[:,(k+1)%3]; direction=end-point
            denom=dot(direction,norm)
            good=np.abs(denom)>1e-15
            frac=np.divide(dot(base-point,norm),denom,out=np.zeros(n),where=good)
            crossing=point+frac[:,None]*direction
            rel=crossing-base; pu=dot(rel,u); pv=dot(rel,v)
            alpha=(vv*pu-uv*pv)/det; beta=(uu*pv-uv*pu)/det
            valid=good&(frac>=0)&(frac<=1)&(alpha>=-1e-13)&(beta>=-1e-13)&(alpha+beta<=1+1e-13)
            hit |= valid
            update(crossing,crossing,valid)
    for i in range(3):
        p=aa[:,i]; u=aa[:,(i+1)%3]-p; uu=dot(u,u)
        for j in range(3):
            q=bb[:,j]; v=bb[:,(j+1)%3]-q; vv=dot(v,v)
            w=p-q; uv=dot(u,v); uw=dot(u,w); vw=dot(v,w)
            for fraction in (0.,1.):
                x=p+fraction*u
                t=np.clip(dot(x-q,v)/vv,0,1)
                update(x,q+t[:,None]*v)
                y=q+fraction*v
                t=np.clip(dot(y-p,u)/uu,0,1)
                update(p+t[:,None]*u,y)
            det=uu*vv-uv*uv
            good=det>1e-14*uu*vv
            ss=np.divide(uv*vw-vv*uw,det,out=np.zeros(n),where=good)
            tt=np.divide(uu*vw-uv*uw,det,out=np.zeros(n),where=good)
            valid=good&(ss>=0)&(ss<=1)&(tt>=0)&(tt<=1)
            update(p+ss[:,None]*u,q+tt[:,None]*v,valid)
    idx=int(np.argmin(best))
    return {'distance':float(np.sqrt(best[idx])),'point_target':pa[idx].tolist(),'point_other':pb[idx].tolist(),'triangle_target':idx//count_b,'triangle_other':idx%count_b,'intersection_pairs':int(hit.sum())}
results={}
for name,(_,_,tri) in geom.items():
    if name=='Mesh_D17AB2': continue
    results[name]=triangle_pair_distances(geom['Mesh_D17AB2'][2],tri)
for name,r in sorted(results.items(),key=lambda x:x[1]['distance']):
    print(name,'distance_mm',format(r['distance']*s.unit_settings.scale_length*1000,'.12f'),r)

def point_face_candidates(points, vertices, faces):
 tri=vertices[faces]
 first=tri[:,0]; edge1=tri[:,1]-first; edge2=tri[:,2]-first
 normal=np.cross(edge1,edge2); normal2=np.einsum('ij,ij->i',normal,normal)
 delta=points[:,None,:]-first[None,:,:]
 height=np.einsum('pfi,fi->pf',delta,normal)/normal2[None,:]
 projected=points[:,None,:]-height[:,:,None]*normal[None,:,:]
 local=projected-first[None,:,:]
 aa=np.einsum('ij,ij->i',edge1,edge1); ab=np.einsum('ij,ij->i',edge1,edge2); bb=np.einsum('ij,ij->i',edge2,edge2)
 la=np.einsum('pfi,fi->pf',local,edge1); lb=np.einsum('pfi,fi->pf',local,edge2)
 denom=aa*bb-ab*ab
 bary1=(la*bb-lb*ab)/denom; bary2=(lb*aa-la*ab)/denom
 valid=(bary1>=-1e-13)&(bary2>=-1e-13)&(bary1+bary2<=1+1e-13)&(normal2[None,:]>0)
 dist2=height*height*normal2[None,:]
 dist2=np.where(valid,dist2,np.inf)
 index=np.unravel_index(np.argmin(dist2),dist2.shape)
 return float(dist2[index]), points[index[0]].copy(),projected[index].copy(),('vertex-face',int(index[0]),int(index[1]))
def unique_edges(faces):
 return np.unique(np.sort(np.concatenate([faces[:,[0,1]],faces[:,[1,2]],faces[:,[2,0]]]),axis=1),axis=0)
def edge_candidates(verts_a,faces_a,verts_b,faces_b):
 edges_a=unique_edges(faces_a); edges_b=unique_edges(faces_b)
 pa=verts_a[edges_a[:,0]][:,None,:]; pb=verts_b[edges_b[:,0]][None,:,:]
 da=(verts_a[edges_a[:,1]]-verts_a[edges_a[:,0]])[:,None,:]
 db=(verts_b[edges_b[:,1]]-verts_b[edges_b[:,0]])[None,:,:]
 diff=pa-pb
 aa=np.sum(da*da,axis=2); bb=np.sum(da*db,axis=2); cc=np.sum(db*db,axis=2)
 dd=np.sum(da*diff,axis=2); ee=np.sum(db*diff,axis=2)
 denom=aa*cc-bb*bb
 candidates=[]
 with np.errstate(divide='ignore',invalid='ignore'):
  sa=(bb*ee-cc*dd)/denom; sb=(aa*ee-bb*dd)/denom
 valid=(denom>1e-25)&(sa>=0)&(sa<=1)&(sb>=0)&(sb<=1)
 candidates.append((sa,sb,valid))
 shape=bb.shape
 for param in (0.,1.):
  sa=np.full(shape,param); sb=np.clip((ee+bb*param)/cc,0,1)
  candidates.append((sa,sb,np.ones(shape,dtype=bool)))
 for param in (0.,1.):
  sb=np.full(shape,param); sa=np.clip((bb*param-dd)/aa,0,1)
  candidates.append((sa,sb,np.ones(shape,dtype=bool)))
 best=(float('inf'),None,None,None)
 for sa,sb,valid in candidates:
  qa=pa+sa[:,:,None]*da; qb=pb+sb[:,:,None]*db
  dist2=np.where(valid,np.sum((qa-qb)**2,axis=2),np.inf)
  index=np.unravel_index(np.argmin(dist2),dist2.shape)
  if dist2[index]<best[0]: best=(float(dist2[index]),qa[index].copy(),qb[index].copy(),('edge-edge',edges_a[index[0]].tolist(),edges_b[index[1]].tolist()))
 return best
results={}
verts_a,faces_a=geometry['Mesh_DDBB95']
for name,(verts_b,faces_b) in geometry.items():
 if name=='Mesh_DDBB95':continue
 candidates=[point_face_candidates(verts_a,verts_b,faces_b)]
 reverse=point_face_candidates(verts_b,verts_a,faces_a)
 candidates.append((reverse[0],reverse[2],reverse[1],('face-vertex',)+reverse[3][1:]))
 candidates.append(edge_candidates(verts_a,faces_a,verts_b,faces_b))
 best=min(candidates,key=lambda candidate:candidate[0]);results[name]=best
 print(name,'minimum_mm',math.sqrt(best[0])*1000,'target_point_mm',(best[1]*1000).tolist(),'other_point_mm',(best[2]*1000).tolist(),'feature',best[3])
print('elapsed_seconds',time.time()-start_time)

import bpy, numpy as np, time
from mathutils.bvhtree import BVHTree
names=['Part_49','Part_17','Part_26','Part_38']
print('units',bpy.context.scene.unit_settings.system,bpy.context.scene.unit_settings.scale_length)
for name in names:
 o=bpy.data.objects.get(name)
 print(name, None if o is None else (o.type,len(o.data.vertices),len(o.data.polygons),list(o.matrix_world.translation),list(o.dimensions)))

dg=bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
meshes={}
for name in names:
 obj=bpy.data.objects[name].evaluated_get(dg); mesh=obj.to_mesh(); mesh.calc_loop_triangles()
 verts=np.array([tuple(obj.matrix_world @ vert.co) for vert in mesh.vertices],dtype=np.float64)
 tris=np.array([tuple(tri.vertices) for tri in mesh.loop_triangles],dtype=int)
 meshes[name]=(verts,tris)
 obj.to_mesh_clear()
 print(name,'bounds',verts.min(axis=0),verts.max(axis=0),'tris',len(tris),'unique verts',len(np.unique(verts,axis=0)))
 print('coordinates',*[np.unique(verts[:,axis]).tolist() for axis in range(3)])

def winding(points,verts,tris):
 vectors=verts[tris][None,:,:,:]-np.asarray(points)[:,None,None,:]
 lengths=np.linalg.norm(vectors,axis=-1)
 aa,bb,cc=vectors[:,:,0],vectors[:,:,1],vectors[:,:,2]
 numerator=np.einsum('pij,pij->pi',aa,np.cross(bb,cc))
 denom=lengths[:,:,0]*lengths[:,:,1]*lengths[:,:,2]+np.einsum('pij,pij->pi',aa,bb)*lengths[:,:,2]+np.einsum('pij,pij->pi',bb,cc)*lengths[:,:,0]+np.einsum('pij,pij->pi',cc,aa)*lengths[:,:,1]
 return np.sum(2*np.arctan2(numerator,denom),axis=1)/(4*np.pi)
basev,baset=meshes['Part_49']
basebvh=BVHTree.FromPolygons(basev.tolist(),baset.tolist(),all_triangles=True,epsilon=0.0)
for name in names[1:]:
 verts,tris=meshes[name]
 bvh=BVHTree.FromPolygons(verts.tolist(),tris.tolist(),all_triangles=True,epsilon=0.0)
 weights=winding(np.concatenate([verts,verts[tris].mean(axis=1),verts.mean(axis=0)[None,:]]),basev,baset)
 print(name,'bvh overlaps',len(basebvh.overlap(bvh)),'winding range',weights.min(),weights.max(),'vertex windings',np.round(weights[:len(verts)],5).tolist(),'center',weights[-1])

def point_tri_min(points, verts, tris):
 triangles=verts[tris]; start=triangles[:,0]; edge1=triangles[:,1]-start; edge2=triangles[:,2]-start
 normal=np.cross(edge1,edge2); normal_sq=np.sum(normal*normal,axis=1)
 offset=points[:,None,:]-start[None,:,:]
 height=np.einsum('pti,ti->pt',offset,normal)/normal_sq
 projected=points[:,None,:]-height[:,:,None]*normal[None,:,:]
 rel=projected-start
 d00=np.sum(edge1*edge1,axis=1);d01=np.sum(edge1*edge2,axis=1);d11=np.sum(edge2*edge2,axis=1)
 d20=np.einsum('pti,ti->pt',rel,edge1);d21=np.einsum('pti,ti->pt',rel,edge2)
 denom=d00*d11-d01*d01
 bary1=(d11*d20-d01*d21)/denom;bary2=(d00*d21-d01*d20)/denom
 good=(bary1>=-1e-12)&(bary2>=-1e-12)&(bary1+bary2<=1+1e-12)
 distances=np.where(good,height*height*normal_sq,np.inf)
 idx=np.unravel_index(np.argmin(distances),distances.shape)
 return float(distances[idx]),points[idx[0]],projected[idx]
def edges_of(tris):
 return np.unique(np.sort(np.concatenate([tris[:,[0,1]],tris[:,[1,2]],tris[:,[2,0]]]),axis=1),axis=0)
def edge_min(verts1,tris1,verts2,tris2):
 edges1=verts1[edges_of(tris1)]; edges2=verts2[edges_of(tris2)]
 start1=edges1[:,0,None,:];start2=edges2[None,:,0,:]
 direction1=(edges1[:,1]-edges1[:,0])[:,None,:];direction2=(edges2[:,1]-edges2[:,0])[None,:,:]
 offset=start1-start2
 aa=np.sum(direction1*direction1,axis=-1);bb=np.sum(direction1*direction2,axis=-1);cc=np.sum(direction2*direction2,axis=-1)
 dd=np.sum(direction1*offset,axis=-1);ee=np.sum(direction2*offset,axis=-1)
 denominator=aa*cc-bb*bb
 safe=np.where(denominator>1e-30,denominator,1)
 ss=(bb*ee-cc*dd)/safe;tt=(aa*ee-bb*dd)/safe
 interior=(denominator>1e-30)&(ss>=0)&(ss<=1)&(tt>=0)&(tt<=1)
 choices=[(ss,tt,interior),(np.zeros_like(dd),np.clip(ee/cc,0,1),True),(np.ones_like(dd),np.clip((ee+bb)/cc,0,1),True),(np.clip(-dd/aa,0,1),np.zeros_like(dd),True),(np.clip((bb-dd)/aa,0,1),np.ones_like(dd),True)]
 best=(np.inf,None,None)
 for ss,tt,valid in choices:
  first=start1+ss[:,:,None]*direction1;second=start2+tt[:,:,None]*direction2
  dist=np.where(valid,np.sum((first-second)**2,axis=-1),np.inf)
  idx=np.unravel_index(np.argmin(dist),dist.shape)
  if dist[idx]<best[0]:best=(float(dist[idx]),first[idx],second[idx])
 return best
for name in ['Part_26','Part_38']:
 verts,tris=meshes[name]
 candidates=[point_tri_min(verts,basev,baset),point_tri_min(basev,verts,tris),edge_min(verts,tris,basev,baset)]
 best=min(candidates,key=lambda item:item[0])
 print(name,'minimum_mm',np.sqrt(best[0])*1000,'witness_world_m',best[1].tolist(),best[2].tolist(),'method_distances_mm',[np.sqrt(item[0])*1000 for item in candidates])
# Strictly interior witness for both overlapping solids, away from their boundaries.
verts,tris=meshes['Part_17']; witness=verts.mean(axis=0)
print('Part_17 interior witness m',witness.tolist(),'windings',winding([witness],verts,tris).tolist(),winding([witness],basev,baset).tolist())
print('Part_17 witness boundary distances mm',basebvh.find_nearest(witness)[3]*1000,BVHTree.FromPolygons(verts.tolist(),tris.tolist(),all_triangles=True).find_nearest(witness)[3]*1000)

def projected_vertex_faces(vertices, triangles):
    base=triangles[:,0]; side1=triangles[:,1]-base; side2=triangles[:,2]-base
    normal=np.cross(side1,side2); norm2=np.einsum('ij,ij->i',normal,normal)
    delta=vertices[:,None,:]-base[None,:,:]
    signed=np.einsum('vti,ti->vt',delta,normal)
    projected=vertices[:,None,:]-np.divide(signed,norm2[None,:],out=np.zeros_like(signed),where=norm2[None,:]>0)[:,:,None]*normal[None,:,:]
    rel=projected-base[None,:,:]
    aa=np.einsum('ij,ij->i',side1,side1); ab=np.einsum('ij,ij->i',side1,side2); bb=np.einsum('ij,ij->i',side2,side2)
    ra=np.einsum('vti,ti->vt',rel,side1); rb=np.einsum('vti,ti->vt',rel,side2)
    det=aa*bb-ab*ab
    u=np.divide(bb*ra-ab*rb,det[None,:],out=np.zeros_like(ra),where=det[None,:]>0)
    v=np.divide(aa*rb-ab*ra,det[None,:],out=np.zeros_like(rb),where=det[None,:]>0)
    valid=(norm2[None,:]>0)&(u>=0)&(v>=0)&(u+v<=1)
    dist2=np.where(valid,np.sum((vertices[:,None,:]-projected)**2,axis=2),np.inf)
    index=np.unravel_index(np.argmin(dist2),dist2.shape)
    return float(dist2[index]),vertices[index[0]].copy(),projected[index].copy(),('vertex-face',int(index[0]),int(index[1]))
def vertex_edges(vertices, edges):
    direction=edges[:,1]-edges[:,0]; denom=np.sum(direction*direction,axis=1)
    rel=vertices[:,None,:]-edges[None,:,0,:]
    t=np.clip(np.divide(np.einsum('vei,ei->ve',rel,direction),denom[None,:],out=np.zeros(rel.shape[:2]),where=denom[None,:]>0),0,1)
    q=edges[None,:,0,:]+t[:,:,None]*direction[None,:,:]
    d2=np.sum((vertices[:,None,:]-q)**2,axis=2)
    idx=np.unravel_index(np.argmin(d2),d2.shape)
    return float(d2[idx]),vertices[idx[0]].copy(),q[idx].copy(),('vertex-edge',int(idx[0]),int(idx[1]))
def interior_edges(edges_a,edges_b):
    first=edges_a[:,1]-edges_a[:,0]; second=edges_b[:,1]-edges_b[:,0]
    delta=edges_a[:,None,0,:]-edges_b[None,:,0,:]
    aa=np.sum(first*first,axis=1)[:,None]; bb=first@second.T; cc=np.sum(second*second,axis=1)[None,:]
    dd=np.einsum('abi,ai->ab',delta,first); ee=np.einsum('abi,bi->ab',delta,second)
    determinant=aa*cc-bb*bb
    s=np.divide(bb*ee-cc*dd,determinant,out=np.zeros_like(dd),where=determinant>0)
    t=np.divide(aa*ee-bb*dd,determinant,out=np.zeros_like(dd),where=determinant>0)
    valid=(determinant>0)&(s>=0)&(s<=1)&(t>=0)&(t<=1)
    p=edges_a[:,None,0,:]+s[:,:,None]*first[:,None,:]
    q=edges_b[None,:,0,:]+t[:,:,None]*second[None,:,:]
    dist2=np.where(valid,np.sum((p-q)**2,axis=2),np.inf)
    idx=np.unravel_index(np.argmin(dist2),dist2.shape)
    return float(dist2[idx]),p[idx].copy(),q[idx].copy(),('edge-edge',int(idx[0]),int(idx[1]),float(s[idx]),float(t[idx]))
def unique_edges(faces):
    return np.unique(np.sort(np.concatenate([faces[:,[0,1]],faces[:,[1,2]],faces[:,[2,0]]]),axis=1),axis=0)
_target_vertices,_target_faces=_geo['Mesh_DDBB95']
_target_triangles=_target_vertices[_target_faces]
_target_edgeids=unique_edges(_target_faces)
_target_edges=_target_vertices[_target_edgeids]
_results={}
for name,(vertices,faces) in _geo.items():
    if name=='Mesh_DDBB95': continue
    triangles=vertices[faces]; edgeids=unique_edges(faces); edges=vertices[edgeids]
    candidates=[projected_vertex_faces(_target_vertices,triangles),vertex_edges(_target_vertices,edges),interior_edges(_target_edges,edges)]
    for fn,args in [(projected_vertex_faces,(vertices,_target_triangles)),(vertex_edges,(vertices,_target_edges))]:
        distance2,point_other,point_target,feature=fn(*args)
        candidates.append((distance2,point_target,point_other,('reversed',feature)))
    best=min(candidates,key=lambda item:item[0]); _results[name]=best
    print(name,'distance_mm',format(math.sqrt(best[0])*1000,'.12f'),'target_point_m',best[1].tolist(),'other_point_m',best[2].tolist(),'feature',best[3], 'unique_edges',len(edgeids))
print('bbox_z_separation_mm',min(v[:,2].min() for name,(v,f) in _geo.items() if name!='Mesh_DDBB95')*1000-_target_vertices[:,2].max()*1000)

    aa=np.einsum('ij,ij->i',side1,side1); ab=np.einsum('ij,ij->i',side1,side2); bb=np.einsum('ij,ij->i',side2,side2)
    ra=np.einsum('vti,ti->vt',rel,side1); rb=np.einsum('vti,ti->vt',rel,side2)
    det=aa*bb-ab*ab
